1.w: Now after the Sabbaths, it being dawn toward the first of the Sabbaths, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

2.w: And behold, there was a great earthquake; for an angel of the Lord, having descended out of heaven and having come, rolled away the stone and was sitting upon it.

3.w: And his appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

4.w: And those keeping guard trembled from fear of him, and they became like dead [men].

5.w: And answering, the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you⁺ seek Jesus, the One having been crucified.

6.w: He is not here, for He is risen, as He said! Come, see the place where He was lying.

7.w: And having gone quickly, say to His disciples, ‘He is risen from the dead, and behold, He goes before you⁺ into Galilee; there you⁺ will see Him.’ Behold, I have told you⁺.”

8.w: And having gone out quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, they ran to tell His disciples.

9.w: And behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Greetings!” And having come, they took hold of His feet and worshiped Him.

10.w: Then Jesus says to them, “Do not be afraid. Go, tell My brothers, so that they should go into Galilee. And there they will see Me.”

11.w: And [in] their going, behold, some of the guard, having gone into the city, reported to the chief priests all the things having come to pass.

12.w: And having been gathered together with the elders and having taken counsel, they gave many pieces of silver to the soldiers,

13.w: saying, “Say, ‘His disciples, having come by night, stole Him—we being asleep.’

14.w: And if this is heard by the governor, we will persuade him, and we will keep you⁺ out of trouble.”

15.w: And having taken the pieces of silver, they did as they were instructed. And this report was spread abroad among the Jews until the present day.

16.w: And the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus assigned them.

17.w: And having seen Him, they worshiped; but some doubted.

18.w: And having come near, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “All authority in heaven and on the earth was given to Me.

19.w: Therefore, having gone, disciple all the nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit,

20.w: teaching them to observe all things, as much as I commanded you⁺. And behold, I am with you⁺ all the days, until the consummation of the age.”
